prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when your insured vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is currently receiving medical treatment.

Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. If you are represented by counsel, please forward this letter to them immediately.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury liability limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this collision, including photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, witness statements, claim file materials, and any recorded statements. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained.
